title.narrative: The role of the church in promoting Participatory Democracy and good governrance for peace

description.narrative: For the two past decades the Eastern part of The DRC has under gone several political unrest. Such tensed situation has left new generation without inspiration. Clashes between different groups has characterised the mind-set of the population, which is dictating the attitude of the population; Local structures such as intercommunity ‘Barza’ and youth clubs have been politicized . Many youth have lost their lives due to some selfish political manipulation that feed their interest. As we approach the election, the Commission of Justice and Peace in Goma ‘CDJP’ intends to inform youth of their rights and obligation. J P Commission will target these structures and will strengthen sensitisation with all possible media, recreation activities, training, open dialogues and conferences and debates with pretended candidates, voters and intercommunity groups of youth and influential leaders in Goma, Sake and Rutshuru in the effort to prevent the escalation of violence. The Catholic Church that raised voice for peace and respect of the Constitution remains credible for presidential and opposition political parties. Through this project , Justice and Peace Commission’s at the national will seek to tackle this unstable context by preparing youths, marginalized and women to avoid tensions, manipulations in the upcoming challenging elections. People need fairly-elected leaders to deliver basic services, and improve security issues around the country. This project aims to improve knowledge about the election process by disseminating programs of voter and civic education, starting now before the local elections and continuing throughout the election process and ensure that the material used is accurate and politically neutral. The Project plans to use sport and music to bring youth together and help them understand the importance of peaceful elections process and how to peacefully claim its rights. SMS messaging will also be used for democratization process within the church.
